nom: DRMTLGY Microdermabrasion Scrub Gentle Physical Exfoliant

avis.texte: This is a great ohysical scrub to be used 1x a week. Mimics a diamond wand. My only complaint is the minty/ menthol in it. I wish it didnt have it. Maje sure to lather well very gently. Remove with towel or sponge not splashing your face. Will purchase again. As far as the smell wish it had none ir a sea salt smell.

I can't believe how well this works! My face was feeling rough and looking dull. Moisturizer alone wasn't helping so I figured i needed something like this. Very happy with the results! Definitely recommend and it hasn't bothered my sensitive skin at all.
